cwd.description: Folder holding CMakePresets.json, relative to the workspace root, every invocation runs in it

configure.description: The cmake invocation that configures the build tree

commands.description: Invocations run in order in the configured tree, stopping at the first failure

args.description: Arguments appended to the last invocation

env.description: Environment variables every invocation runs with, over the caller's

outputs.description: Files the invocations write, which the target's outputs name through {options.outputs.<n>}, each folder created before the run

title: CMake
description: Configures a CMake build tree with its configure invocation, then runs the cmake, ctest, and clang tool invocations of the target in order, stopping at the first failure
